english: At present, they are visiting all parts of the country.
text: 中文说“全国各地”容易直译成 all places of the country，这里用 all parts of the country 更自然，是泛指各地、四处走的常见说法。讲巡演、出差这类遍及各地的行程，用 all parts 比 all places 更地道。
author: doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628
